title: Bledsoe's craft bigger inside than outside

tellings.quote: Chris Bless tells the story 30t on the outside and he looks inside and it's the size of a football game.

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe says he saw a craft that was about 30 feet across on the outside, but when he looked inside it seemed as big as a football field. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron repeats this to Michels as Bledsoe tells it. If true, it would mean the craft bends space in a way known physics cannot.
